sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Bhupendra Singh Chauhan,Anil Kumar Maurya,Devi Prasad Maurya,Sa Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Brij Raj Singh,J.
1. Heard Shri Devi Prasad Maurya, learned counsel for the accused-applicant as well as Shri Ravish Chandra Mishra, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. This bail application has been filed seeking release of the accused/applicant Arvind Gautam on bail, who is involved in Case Crime No. 359 of 2022, under Sections 306, 376 I.P.C.& Section 67 I.T Act, Police Station Atrauli, District Hardoi.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case and at the relevant time of death of deceased, the applicant was not present at the place of occurrence.
He further submitted that the deceased committed suicide and the suicide note written by the deceased has no relevance and he has submitted that the said suicide note was not written by the deceased.

He has further submitted that the allegation of rape against the applicant is not proved and the charge-sheet has been filed under Section 67 of the I.T Act,
Arvind Gautam vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 17 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172362838/
1 which is also not sustainable because no offence has been committed by the applicant and the Investigating Officer has not collected the obscene material and photographs.

entities.text: Arvind Gautam vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel further submitted that there is no criminal history against the applicant and he is languishing in jail since 20.07.2022.

4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for grant of bail and has drawn attention of the Court towards the suicide note of the deceased wherein she has stated that the applicant had committed rape on her on the pretext of making the obscene material and photographs of the deceased viral.
The deceased in her suicide note further mentioned that she was in love with one Alok and for that reason the applicant had enmity with him.
She further mentioned that she was committing suicide only because the applicant had made her obscene videos and photographs viral (mentioned in para-18 of the counter affidavit).

Learned A.G.A further submitted that the statement of complainant Monu and witnesses namely Smt Kiran and Smt. Phoolmati have been recorded and all of them have stated that the applicant committed rape on the deceased on the pretext of making her obscene video and photographs viral.

Learned A.G.A has further drawn attention of the Court towards the statement of one Pradeep Kumar, the cousin brother of the deceased who has stated that the Arvind had sentthe obscene photographs and video of the deceased to co-accused Alok mentioning therein that he had established physical relation with the deceased.

He further mentioned that due to this act of the applicant as well as of the co-accused, the deceased committed suicide, therefore the applicant does not deserve mercy of the Court as he has committed a heinous crime, thus, the bail application of the applicant is liable to be rejected.

5. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, perusing the record and also considering the nature of allegations, arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the parties, particularly the statement of one Pradeep, the cousin brother of deceased and statements of all other witnesses which indicates that the applicant had made viral the obscene photographs and video of the deceased that is why she committed suicide.
The suicide note of the deceased which is on record indicates that the applicant was involved in abatement of crime, I do not find it to be a fit case for grant of bail.

6. The bail application of the accused/applicantArvind Gautam is hereby rejected.
